[h2][b]Coming Soon![/b][/h2]


[h3]We are finishing up the beta and [b]will be officially releasing the game on Steam[/b]. We have completely overhauled the referral system and prepared [b]many updates[/b], one of which is tasks that allow you to earn [b]new currency[/b] by completing them and spend it on...


And much, much more...[/h3]

notes.title: 👻 Beta Access!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45086756/f821f0f8785b90a2f3dd799296a031ad61f402f4.png[/img]

[h2][b]Beta Access![/b][/h2]


[h3]Many of you have been eagerly waiting for this moment, and to be honest, so have we. Starting now, the [b]key distribution[/b] begins. After discussing with the team, we've decided on just one condition —


To get a key, you need to invite [b]4 people to our [url=https://discord.gg/wgt6JkHw9B]Discord server[/url][/b]. This way, there won't be too many players in the beta, creating a sort of whitelist. Any previous invites also count!





[i]P.S. After inviting 4+ friends, you will receive a special role. This role is not just to make it easier to find beta testers, who knows ;)[/i][/h3]




https://store.steampowered.com/app/3061430/Caspers/

notes.title: 👻 Beta test!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45086756/fe8fffcb90368ecb5f4e55e7859a0126bd0d3303.png[/img][h2]
[b]Keys[/b][/h2]

[h3]We will soon commence the giveaway for beta testers. Do not worry; [b]the beta will happen[/b], albeit a little later. This delay is necessary at this stage of project development to properly prepare and explain to the community [b]what lies ahead[/b] and to conduct the giveaway in a way that maximizes overall benefit for the project.

[i][b]Approx. date: July 19-20[/b][/i][/h3]

notes.content:

[h2][b]Release Coming Soon![/b][/h2]

[h3]Just a reminder, after the game is released, there will be only [b]2 types[/b] of ghosts available: [b]common and rare[/b]. This is designed to make it easier and more convenient to manage prices, rather than dealing with hundreds of items that you physically can't keep up with.[/h3]

notes.content:

[h1]Release Coming Soon![/h1]

[h3]I’m excited to announce that our game is about to be [b]released on Steam![/b] The release date is set for July 16-17, just a [b]week[/b] away!

To stay updated with the latest news and updates, join our[url=https://discord.gg/u6cGhsYC] Discord server [/url]!

[b]My only advice - hodl, dyor, enjoy[/b][/h3]
